tvShow.name: President Curtis
tvShow.overview: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: As Curtis goes head-to-head with the CIA over a secret tape, he's forced to confront secrets of his own.

guest_stars.character: Stuckey / A.I. Bomb / White House Reporter (voice)
guest_stars.name: Danielle Uhlarik

episodes.name: Triangle
episodes.overview: After a dead Loch Ness monster washes ashore, Curtis, Banks, and O'Doyle investigate a secret monster prison in the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.name: Ex
episodes.overview: Curtis gets invited to his ex-wife's inauguration gala. Banks and O'Doyle must undergo a job evaluation at a fully-immersive offsite facility.

episodes.name: Purchase
episodes.overview: After finding an addendum on the Louisiana Purchase receipt, Curtis must race against old enemies and friends to hold control of the territory.

episodes.name: David
episodes.overview: After butting heads with his own Party, Curtis visits Camp David to undergo a true test of his Presidential prowess.

guest_stars.character: Chef Matteo / Party Leader #3 / Trent McGaffin's Father (voice)
guest_stars.name: Jon Glaser

guest_stars.character: David the Water Witch / President Curtis' Imaginary Son (voice)
guest_stars.name: Cree Summer

episodes.name: Hollow
episodes.overview: When America faces a national energy crisis, Curtis and his team venture deep into Hollow Earth to find a solution.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: When Banks contracts malware, O'Doyle enters her computer brain to find a fix. Meanwhile, Curtis gives the ghost of President Lincoln a gift that empowers him to settle his unfinished business.

episodes.name: Knox
episodes.overview: A robbery at Fort Knox puts Curtis and the FBI on a manhunt for the culprit, forcing O'Doyle to confront figures from his past to get to the bottom of it.
